allow: PowerShell($procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'next' }; if \($procs\) { $procs | Select-Object ProcessId, @{n='Cmd';e={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(80,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "No hay procesos node/next corriendo" })

PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($null -eq $c\) { "Nada escuchando en el puerto 3000" } else { $c | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String; $c.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "PID $\($p.Id\) : $\($p.ProcessName\) : $\($p.Path\)" } else { "PID $_ : \(proceso no encontrado\)" } } })

PowerShell(foreach \($port in 3000,3001\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($null -eq $c\) { "Puerto ${port}: libre" } else { $pids = \($c.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique\) -join ','; "Puerto ${port}: OCUPADO por PID $pids" } })

PowerShell($p = Get-Process -Id 15592 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "PID 15592 -> $\($p.ProcessName\) | $\($p.Path\)"; $cmd = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 15592"\).CommandLine; "CMD: $cmd" } else { "PID 15592 ya no existe" })

PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(45\); $ok = $false; while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline -and -not $ok\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/admin/login" -MaximumRedirection 0 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; $ok = $true; "Servidor arriba -> /admin/login responde $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { if \($_.Exception.Response\) { $ok = $true; "Servidor arriba -> /admin/login responde $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } else { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } } }; if \(-not $ok\) { "El servidor no respondio en 45s" })
